sources.title: Lyria 3 Clip preview API specifications
sources.evidence: Exact identifier lyria-3-clip-preview: 30-second music clips; text/image input; MP3 audio and text lyrics output; 131,072 input tokens. Thinking and function calling explicitly unsupported. This page says 48 kHz. Freshly reopened October 27: the complete exact-model specification lists API inputs, output length, token limit and capabilities, but no model-weight total, active count or named base checkpoint.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes, March 25, 2026
sources.evidence: Explicitly launches lyria-3-clip-preview for 30-second clips on March 25, 2026, alongside the separate Pro variant.

sources.title: Lyria 3 model card, updated March 2026
sources.evidence: The card explicitly covers Lyria 3 and subsequent versions. Architecture is latent diffusion over temporal audio latents; distribution is through hosted products and APIs. No total or active parameter count is disclosed. Read both HTML and linked PDF. Fresh October 27 review reread the entire HTML card and all five linked PDF pages. Its architecture reference points to the general 2020 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models paper, not a Lyria-specific architecture report or sized base model. The card gives no layer dimensions, total or active count.

sources.title: Build with Lyria 3, our newest music generation model
sources.evidence: March 25, 2026 announcement identifies Lyria 3 Clip (lyria-3-clip-preview), its 30-second output and public Gemini API/AI Studio preview. Both Clip and Pro accept images and text; only Clip specifications are applied here. Freshly reopened October 27. It explicitly calls Clip and Pro distinct Lyria 3 variants but gives neither a sized base model nor unchanged-weight lineage to a model with a published count.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Governs Gemini API and AI Studio service access and prohibits extracting or replicating underlying models, including parameter weights. Supports proprietary hosted-service classification; documentation and code-sample licenses are not model licenses.

sources.title: Music generation guide
sources.evidence: Current guide still names lyria-3-clip-preview separately from Lyria 3.5 and specifies fixed 30-second Clip output with text/image inputs and audio plus lyrics. It says 44.1 kHz, conflicting with the exact API page and launch changelog wording.

sources.title: Lyria 3.5 model card, July 2026
sources.evidence: Later model card was checked for retrospective Lyria 3 specifications; it supplies no total or active count for Lyria 3 Clip. Its own architecture is not transferred to Clip. Freshly reopened and reread the complete July card October 27. It reports latent diffusion and qualitative comparisons with Lyria 2, with no parameter table, retrospective Clip count or unchanged-weight relationship that supports inheriting a size.

sources.title: Google Cloud Lyria 3 model specifications
sources.evidence: Separate 3 Clip Preview section names the exact model ID, March 25 preview release, 30-second MP3 output, image-to-music and lyrics support, and 44.1 kHz audio. Hosted access is subject to Google Cloud preview terms. Freshly reopened the exact Clip section October 27. No total or active-weight size is specified; the page’s request quotas and generation controls are not neural parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini API model lifecycle
sources.evidence: Lyria table gives lyria-3-clip-preview a March 25, 2026 release and no announced shutdown date as inspected. This documents lifecycle status, not a successful inference test.

sources.title: Lyria 3 original model-card PDF
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded and read the complete five-page PDF October 27. Updated March 2026, it covers Lyria 3 and subsequent versions and discloses temporal-audio latent diffusion. Neither total nor active parameters are specified. The qualitative Lyria 2 comparison is not unchanged-checkpoint lineage.

sources.title: Magenta RealTime: An Open-Weights Live Music Model
sources.evidence: Freshly read the original June 20, 2025 launch while checking possible sized-base lineage. Its 800-million-parameter autoregressive transformer is Magenta RealTime, described as a cousin of Lyria RealTime. It adapts MusicLM for block autoregression. This is not a claim that latent-diffusion Lyria 3 Clip is its fine-tune or shares its weight count.

sources.title: Magenta RealTime 2: Open & Local Live Music Models
sources.evidence: Freshly read the original later-model comparison. The 2.4B/230M sizes refer to Magenta RealTime 2 codec language models with frame-level autoregression; older 760M/220M sizes refer to Magenta RealTime. No explicit unchanged-base link to Lyria 3 Clip is given, so these counts cannot fill Clip’s missing parameters.

name.note: Official display name for the exact Clip preview API identifier.

developer.note: Published by Google; launch authors are from Google DeepMind.

release_date.note: Exact public API preview date. The February Lyria 3 app/model-card publication does not establish earlier availability of this API identifier.

open_weights.note: Hosted API/product release with proprietary access terms; no public checkpoint distribution is offered for this model.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification, not an SPDX claim or the license of documentation/code samples.

parameters_b.note: October 27 re-audit freshly reopened the exact Clip API and Cloud specifications, original launch, complete original card/PDF and later Lyria 3.5 card. Exact-model and family searches for parameter count, billion-scale sizes, technical reports and original benchmark comparisons found no supported published total. The explicit Clip-to-Lyria 3 family relationship supplies no sized base. Magenta RealTime’s 800M and later 2.4B/230M releases are separate autoregressive models, not documented unchanged bases for this latent-diffusion model.

active_parameters_b.note: October 27 fresh searches separately covered active/activated parameters and original comparison tables across arXiv, Google Research, DeepMind and model-card sources. The exact Clip documents and full original/later cards disclose no active-weight or per-diffusion-step counting convention. The generic diffusion-paper link and nearby RealTime-model sizes establish neither an active count nor transferable named-base lineage. Retained null rather than inferring active equals an unknown total.

architecture.note: The card explicitly covers Lyria 3 and subsequent versions; the launch identifies Clip as a Lyria 3 variant. Temporal-audio latent diffusion is disclosed, while backbone details and dense/MoE classification are not.

context_window.note: Documented API input-token limit, not a generated-audio duration or a demonstrated conversational context. Third-party catalogs reporting 1,048,576 are not used over this exact first-party specification.

modalities.note: API-level modalities: text/image prompts produce music and textual lyrics. The core model card lists text input; the API explicitly adds image support. Do not transfer Gemini-app video input or cover-art output to this endpoint.

reasoning.note: The exact API capability table explicitly marks Thinking unsupported.

tool_call.note: The exact API capability table explicitly marks Function calling unsupported.

description.value: Google music-generation model that produces 30-second clips and lyrics from text or image prompts.
description.note: Describes the exact Clip endpoint without Pro song-length claims or promotional quality language; it is a music generator, not a general chat model.

patch.description: Google music-generation model that produces 30-second clips and lyrics from text or image prompts.

sources.label: Build with Lyria 3, our newest music generation model
Gemini API Additional Terms of Service

patch.notes: Lyria 3 uses latent diffusion over audio latents. Google has not published total or active parameter counts for Clip. The 131,072-token value is the API input limit; Clip output is fixed at 30 seconds. The exact API page says 48 kHz, while the current generation guide and Google Cloud specification say 44.1 kHz. The March 25 date is the public Clip API preview release.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: total and active counts remain undisclosed after fresh exact-model specifications, original card/PDF, release and later-card review, independent total/active searches and named-base checks. Magenta RealTime sizes do not transfer to the distinct latent-diffusion Clip model. Preserves the twelve nonparameter assessments, including API identity, release, modalities and the sample-rate conflict.
